fixtures.description: One parked episode crosses an out-of-area slice and returns in-area; the middle exclusion must not create fresh stationary allowance.

A.payable: At most one shared grace across the full parked episode; out-of-area time itself is never payable.
A.excluded: Middle slice is out_of_area; confirmed stationary time after grace remains excluded before and after it.
A.explanation: out_of_area has outcome precedence but does not reset detector/grace state

B.payable: Long-stay grace only; no fresh allowance on re-entry.
B.excluded: Middle slice is out_of_area and remaining long-stay time is stationary after grace.
B.explanation: area transitions do not reset stationary state or spent budget

C.excluded: Middle slice is out_of_area; remaining long-stay time is stationary.
C.explanation: area exclusion cannot be used to renew grace or erase evidence

fixtures.description: Short stationary evidence appears before and after an interval whose position is unknown.

A.payable: Gap seconds are never payable; pre/post-gap rolling runs are evaluated independently because the detector resets.
A.excluded: Gap is gps_gap; confirmed rolling-stationary windows are excluded after shared grace.

B.payable: Gap is excluded; spent short-stay budget is retained across the gap and cannot be replenished by missing data.
B.excluded: gps_gap plus candidate time strictly above the one scope budget.
B.explanation: gap ends the positional episode but not the spent budget

C.payable: Gap is excluded; otherwise valid time remains gross-payable.
C.held: Evidence before and after the gap remains in the selected scope and can trigger a hold; no displacement is inferred across the gap.
C.explanation: gap retains suspicion evidence but supplies no position claim

fixtures.description: Low accuracy, null accuracy and teleport intervals overlap stationary-looking evidence and must win the reason precedence.

A.payable: Only the valid slice can become payable or rolling-stationary.
A.excluded: Low and null accuracy map to low_accuracy; teleport maps to teleport before stationary policy.

B.payable: Only the valid slice can spend the sub-window budget.
B.excluded: Low/null accuracy and teleport retain their existing reasons; they do not consume new-policy evidence.
B.explanation: invalid position cannot manufacture or erase stationary budget evidence

C.payable: Only the valid slice is gross-payable.
C.excluded: Low/null accuracy and teleport retain precedence.
C.held: Only valid short-pattern evidence can contribute to the trigger.
C.explanation: invalid signal is not fraud-policy movement evidence

fixtures.description: A stationary episode begins outside the campaign window and continues inside it; the boundary controls pay but does not reset evidence.

A.payable: Out-of-window seconds are never payable; in-window time receives no fresh detector/grace state.
A.excluded: First slice is out_of_window; later confirmed stationary time is excluded after the one shared grace.

B.payable: Out-of-window seconds are never payable; any short-budget state spent there remains spent on entry.
B.excluded: out_of_window plus stationary time above the applicable allowance.
B.explanation: campaign eligibility boundary is not a farming reset

C.payable: Only the in-window slice is gross-payable.
C.held: Valid positional evidence on both sides can trigger a hold of the in-window payable slice.
C.explanation: out-of-window evidence can inform review but cannot earn
